instruction.name: xvsetanyeqz.h
instruction.description: Set the condition code if any h element is non-zero/equal to zero.

latencies.notes: vj -> fcc. The chain closes through movcf2gr (7 cycles) and vreplgr2vr.w (1 cycle), so 10 cycles of helper latency are subtracted; treat the value as approximate. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc7, $xr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetanyeqz.h $fcc7, $xr15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
